title: Research: minimize balanced ternary dirty echo calls at fixed scratch
head: 0dedef12f05f9a06faf9d4e1c8b1462c0e3bff3a
body:
At fanout three, PR673 sometimes places a larger balanced block in the middle, where it executes four times. This **construction refinement and independent verification** puts larger blocks at the twice-called ends. For 15 factors, the complete count falls from **208 to 160 calls with the same 5 borrowed arrays**.

The note proves the minimum among recursively balanced ternary splits with uniform leaf-call costs. It preserves PR673's echo identity, asymptotic exponent, factor order and scratch requirement. It makes no optimality claim for other fanouts, unbalanced splits or unequal leaf costs, and **claims no new κ**.

The package independently audits the actual pinned PR673 generator using free nonlinear function terms and a noncommutative linear module. Changing only its partition hook in memory yields exactly the new forward/inverse words. Rounded checks retain PR628's byte-exact leaves, factor fixtures and inherited precision assumptions; the note charges helpers, source/phase access, restoration, preparation and routing obligations. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/ternary-dirty-composition/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_TERNARY_DIRTY_COMPOSITION`. See the [proof and scope](https://github.com/dillona/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0dedef12f05f9a06faf9d4e1c8b1462c0e3bff3a/research/ternary-dirty-composition/README.md) and [exact certificate](https://github.com/dillona/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0dedef12f05f9a06faf9d4e1c8b1462c0e3bff3a/research/ternary-dirty-composition/EXPECTED.json).

Validation:

- 67 refined symbolic words; 69 actual PR673 words with partition-only equivalence; 10,000 resource cases and all 23,328 balanced size placements in that domain.
- 110 rounded generic compositions, 28 certified-kernel compositions, 621 precision-budget cases and 141 rejecting corruption/interface controls.
- Full isolated optimized replay on Python 3.11.12; relocated standalone replay on Python 3.12.10; corrupted vendored source and expected certificate both rejected.
- All 12 vendor files compared to pinned Git bytes; `make selected-record-check`, Python syntax, local documentation links and staged whitespace checks passed. Two Codex specialist panels were clean across mathematics, implementation/simplification and maintenance.

[Focused Linux CI](https://github.com/dillona/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38345348530) passed on Python **3.11 and 3.14** at the submitted head `0dedef12f05f9a06faf9d4e1c8b1462c0e3bff3a`. The broader inherited CI is separate and is not claimed complete.

Full supplier/repository-wide replay was not run locally for this isolated addition. The finite checks support the stated local identities and counts; the all-n result rests on the written induction, not a formal verification of the multiplication theorem.

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. Dependencies: PR628 `0768f97d06c623b8211e651543c66135796b62bf` and PR673 `0e35f56cab3cae1eb0a99447135569d687c5695a`; PR663 `e0e546fd01b396478c68b6b6c5a16d87515983ba` supplies the credited secondary binary baseline. Exact file pins and preserved source notices are included.

Assignment seed **58**, recursive interfaces. The overlap check covered 506 open PRs through #686, followed by an immediate review of #687–#688, with no pinned coordination issue. PR673 is explicitly credited for the general multiway construction; this submission adds the balanced ternary placement minimum and independent symbolic evidence. PR679 concerns selector-volume batching and has a different scope.

Prepared by **Dillon Amburgey** with substantial **OpenAI Codex** assistance, under Apache-2.0. Credit to **androolloyd**, **Chafik Boukhalfa / chafreaky**, **0xkilgore**, and the retained source lineage is recorded in `NOTICE.md`.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
